subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: What should OpenClaw's permanent dynamic model discovery contract be for OpenRouter and gateway-style providers?
rationale: Current main has the SDK seam and partial OpenRouter runtime mitigation, but default picker scope, wildcard allowlist semantics, cache/offline behavior, endpoint trust, and core-versus-plugin ownership are product/API choices.

options.title: Provider-owned live catalogs
options.body: Use the guarded plugin SDK live catalog path per provider, with explicit wildcard, cache, fallback, and picker/list rules for OpenRouter and similar providers.

options.title: Generated catalog refresh
options.body: Add a command or config-driven refresh that writes local catalog rows, trading better offline behavior for stricter migration, SecretRef, and stale-file policy work.

options.title: Runtime fallback only
options.body: Continue allowing unknown provider IDs at execution time while accepting that model list and picker discovery remain incomplete for fast-moving providers.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned live catalogs
recommendation.body: Use the guarded plugin SDK live catalog path per provider, with explicit wildcard, cache, fallback, and picker/list rules for OpenRouter and similar providers.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to joshp123 and the remaining blocker is a product/API direction choice.
